_comment: Octail's own egg (LinuxGSM's cmwserver settings, its PCServer-UDKGame.ini and its Chivalry fixes were read as a reference only). App 220070 (Chivalry: Medieval Warfare Dedicated Server) from anonymous SteamCMD, the Linux build Binaries/Linux/UDKGameServer-Linux started from its folder with the map URL (map?steamsockets), -seekfreeloadingserver, -configsubdir=octail, -Port and -QueryPort. The install writes Binaries/Linux/steam_appid.txt (219640, LinuxGSM's fix) and copies the shipped UDKGame/Config/*.ini once into UDKGame/Config/octail/, which the server reads and updates don't overwrite; the ini parser sets the name, slots and the admin and join passwords in octail/PCServer-UDKGame.ini before every start. Query port +2 (automatic variable, A2S: player count and the Players tab list); the port after the game port is kept free as in LinuxGSM's defaults. The server reads no console input; start detected by the game port (UDP) from 30 s on; stop with Ctrl+C. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times (its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration"), the steamcmd download times out and retries, and the install fails when the server binary is missing. SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Chivalry: Medieval Warfare
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Chivalry: Medieval Warfare is a first-person melee combat game by Torn Banner Studios: swords, axes and siege weapons in team objective, team deathmatch, free for all and duel modes.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Chivalry: Medieval Warfare dedicated server (Octail's own install script; LinuxGSM's cmwserver settings were read as
# a reference only). App 220070, the Linux build, anonymous SteamCMD. Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -uo pipefail

## anonymous login: the Chivalry: Medieval Warfare server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps # steamapps: SteamCMD's disk write error when it is missing
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz; then
    echo "Installation failed: SteamCMD couldn't be downloaded."
    exit 1
fi
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise, even running as root; the files are given to the server's user after the install.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install the server with steamcmd (the Linux depot)
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
BETA=()
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || BETA=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${BETA[@]}" validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 and 64 bit Steam client libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
BIN=/mnt/server/Binaries/Linux/UDKGameServer-Linux
if [[ ! -f "$BIN" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Chivalry: Medieval Warfare dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x "$BIN"

## LinuxGSM's fix: the server looks for the game's Steam app id (219640, Chivalry itself) next to its binary
[[ -f /mnt/server/Binaries/Linux/steam_appid.txt ]] || echo 219640 > /mnt/server/Binaries/Linux/steam_appid.txt

## Octail: the server runs with -configsubdir=octail and reads UDKGame/Config/octail/, a copy of the shipped
## UDKGame/Config/*.ini made once (updates overwrite the shipped files, not the copy). Octail sets the name, slots and
## passwords in octail/PCServer-UDKGame.ini before every start.
cd /mnt/server/UDKGame/Config || exit 1
if [[ ! -f octail/PCServer-UDKGame.ini ]]; then
    mkdir -p octail
    cp -n ./*.ini octail/
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The first map. Its prefix picks the game mode: AOCTD- team deathmatch (AOCTD-Frigid_p), AOCFFA- free for all (AOCFFA-Moor_p), AOCTO- team objective, AOCLTS- last team standing, AOCKOTH- king of the hill, AOCDUEL- duel. The rotation is in UDKGame/Config/octail/PCServer-UDKGame.ini.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: The password for the in-game admin login (adminlogin <password> in the game console).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = anyone can join.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (UDP), passed as -QueryPort. Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Chivalry: Medieval Warfare dedicated server.

variables.name: Beta Branch
variables.description: Optional: a Steam beta branch of the server; empty for the public build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1), or start the installed files (0). Players can only join a server of their own game version.
